stops.note: a member of the learned priestly class of the Celtic Gauls, from a Celtic compound meaning roughly "strong seer"
recorded by Roman writers describing the priestly class of the Gauls and Britons
revived in Renaissance French scholarship from the Latin term
adopted from French for the ancient Celtic priesthood
stops.meaning: a priest of ancient Celtic religion

current_meaning: a priest or figure of ancient Celtic religion, often linked to nature worship
